title: [dogfood:P1] H3Client sends json=model_dump() — Message.timestamp (datetime) crashes serialization; loop masks it as EndReason 'error'
detail: Any consumer passing the ordinary documented Message field timestamp (datetime, protocol.py:65) hits 'TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable' inside httpx, because client.py:111 and client.py:141 POST json=req.model_dump() instead of model_dump(mode='json'). The loop's broad except then returns the end-reason string 'error' with the traceback log-only — timestamped messages are exactly what a real chat host sends first. Fix: model_dump(mode='json') in both POSTs + a regression test; optionally surface client-side exceptions per DF2-H3-SHIM-2's on_error proposal.
